description: This is a Java source file containing integration tests for the Notification API in the Apache Fineract project. It defines a test class NotificationApiTest with setup procedures and test methods to verify notification retrieval functionalities.

classes.name: NotificationApiTest
classes.description: This class contains integration tests for the Notification API, including setup and verification of notification retrieval having no notifications and one notification available.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment, creates a user with specific roles, and prepares request specifications for authenticated requests.

methods.name: testNotificationRetrievalWorksWhenNoNotificationsAreAvailable
methods.description: Verifies that retrieving notifications when none are available still returns a valid response.

methods.name: testNotificationRetrievalWorksWhenOneNotificationIsAvailable
methods.description: Creates a client, waits for notification to appear, then verifies the notification's content and attributes.
